reason: себя is the reflexive pronoun and is not restricted to the first person; ‘myself’ alone is misleading without a first-person context.
численность denotes the number or headcount of a population, force, or group; generic ‘size’ obscures the counting sense.
казать is an archaic/intransitive verb meaning ‘to seem’ or ‘to appear’; ‘to show’ belongs to показать/указать and does not fit this headword.
